title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theatre, U. Of California on 1984-07-14
source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC > AIFF > Final Cut w/EQ > Soundtrack Pro > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16

ai_review.summary: Excellent matrix recording that blends soundboard clarity with audience ambience, capturing a short but killer selection of tunes.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about Hunter Seamons' matrix work, noting the superb blend of a high‑quality soundboard feed and audience ambiance. The concert itself is described as a shorter set, yet the tune selection is praised as “killer,” indicating a strong musical flow despite its brevity.

ai_rating.rationale: Both 5‑star reviews highlight an outstanding recording and a solid, well‑chosen set; with only two brief reviews confidence is limited but the consensus is clearly positive.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers compare the matrix to a perfect recipe—crisp soundboard foundation plus well‑balanced audience spice; no flaws mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Shorter show but praised for a killer selection of tunes, indicating a tight and satisfying set despite limited length.
